pause_trimming.description: Trim standard silence gaps to 0.35s and dramatic pauses to 0.55s, maintaining natural breath pacing.

pacing.target_speed: 1.267x speed factor (118.52s target duration for full 299-word benchmark script)

script_guidelines.emotion_tags: Use bracketed tags at line start: [sad], [cheerful], [happy], [excited], [angry], [whisper], [dramatic], [normal].
script_guidelines.punctuation: Use periods (.) for falling intonation, ellipses (...) for dramatic anticipation, exclamation marks (!) for high-energy punchlines.
script_guidelines.structure: One thought or emotion segment per block.
